statement: Kong Wang (Void) is traditionally read as a 'hollowing out' of whichever pillar's themes it falls on — reduced substance or follow-through there, though classical texts stress this is neutral rather than purely negative, since voiding an unfavorable influence can help.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard BaZi literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
